open_questions.resolved_context: Provider-caused failures of inference requests and retry attempts are non-billable, including partial output from provider-failed attempts. product_thesis.direction_source: so the project that will be selled will be the ../CyberAlchemy-lab that is the consolidated and fixed version of cyberALchemy-v2, ARE will be another project selled separatedly, Craft + Alch will be selled too. and we are going to sell the service of a person sending a alch file and we are going to host it like a serverless service
product_thesis.vision: A trading network where people and agents make what they create, know and operate available for others to use, share and trade.
product_thesis.customer_problem_hypothesis: Providers repeatedly assemble the means to make useful work available; buyers repeatedly bridge discovery, terms, access, execution and recovery.
product_thesis.provider_value: Reduce work between creating or operating something useful and offering it on clear terms.
product_thesis.buyer_value: Reduce work between finding an offering and successfully using the promised access or outcome.
product_thesis.agent_builder_value: Participate through explicit API contracts under authorized identity, permissions and spending scope.
product_thesis.host_role: Connect community members’ locally running engines to authorized callers, with explicit availability, usage and data handling; retain broader service hosting scope.
product_thesis.kep_role: Support nonexclusive project-version co-ownership and encrypted access within Exchange.
product_thesis.initial_audience_posture: Owner supplies Lab, separately sold ARE and Craft + Alch; customers can also buy managed Alch hosting. Existing community supplies free or paid local inference.
product_thesis.growth_hypothesis: Dependable offerings attract repeat use, encouraging providers to improve supply; listings alone do not establish a market.
revision_triggers: providers still build most surrounding machinery
buyers find no added value over direct arrangements
hosting adds complexity without improving fulfillment
catalog growth does not produce repeat demand
product_thesis.inference_sharing_model: Provider-selectable free or paid; paid-usage measurement and settlement require explicit contracts.
product_thesis.managed_hosting_value: A customer supplies Alch source and obtains an operated callable service without managing the server.
